message: Nothing was changed: 4 blocks cannot be mirrored for the counter spindle: 2 blocks with a rotary axis away from 0, 1 thread block, 1 roughing cycle block. Machine 'Lathe 1': numbers are read as written.

findings.message: N40 G85 NLAP1 D2. F0.3 U0.4 W0.1: a roughing cycle that works from a contour (its finishing allowance along Z has a direction); gEdit does not mirror it yet.

N50 G33 X30. Z-20. F1.5: a thread or tapping move or cycle: mirrored in Z it would cut the other hand of thread unless the counter spindle turns the other way, which the program does not say. Write the threads for the counter spindle by hand.
N70 G102 X30. C90. L5. F100.: a rotary axis moves to an angle other than 0 here, or stands at one; turning or mirroring the path would need its angle changed too, which gEdit does not do.
N80 G0 X60. Z5.: a rotary axis moves to an angle other than 0 here, or stands at one; turning or mirroring the path would need its angle changed too, which gEdit does not do.
